BrochureContent.Content:
A superbly appointed three-bedroom semi-detached home, ideally positioned in a quiet and private cul-de-sac, 11 Tullyhall Crescent is a truly impressive property that has been extensively extended and upgraded within the last five years. No stone has been left unturned in creating a wonderful contemporary home that is equally suited to a growing family, first-time buyer or anyone looking for a turnkey property with exceptional attention to detail.
From the moment you step inside, the quality and level of finish are immediately apparent. The property has been thoughtfully reconfigured and modernised throughout, creating generous, versatile living accommodation with a particularly impressive open-plan living, dining and kitchen area to the rear.
The entrance hall provides a welcoming introduction to the home, with attractive finishes and practical storage. To the front is a spacious living room which has been beautifully finished with full-height wall panelling to all four walls, recessed lighting and laminate flooring. 
The entrance hall also benefits from a modern guest WC. Finished in a contemporary style.
To the rear of the property is undoubtedly one of its most impressive features: an exceptional open-plan living, dining and kitchen space which has been designed around modern family life. Bright, spacious and beautifully finished, this is a versatile area that works equally well for everyday living, entertaining and relaxing.
The kitchen is exceptionally well appointed and forms the centrepiece of this wonderful open-plan space. A substantial central island incorporates both storage and seating for four, creating a practical and sociable area for casual dining, morning coffee or entertaining guests. The kitchen itself features attractive Shaker-style wall and floor storage units, providing an abundance of useful storage, together with an integrated double oven and microwave.
The contrasting colour palette works particularly well, with dark navy cabinetry complemented by grey countertops and matching grey splashback with clever overhead downlighting. A stainless-steel sink with mixer tap completes the contemporary finish. 
The entire kitchen area is finished with laminate flooring, which flows seamlessly through to the adjoining living and dining space, creating a strong sense of continuity.
The family room and dining area has been thoughtfully designed with a combination of style and practicality. Acoustic wall panelling provides a striking feature wall, incorporating a shelf for the television with additional storage beneath. 
To the side, a beautifully finished mirrored-back recessed storage/ display area provides an elegant focal point and additional shelving.
Completing the ground floor accommodation is a highly practical utility room, cleverly designed to maximise space and functionality. The room provides designated space for a washing machine and dryer, together with the property's gas boiler.
Upstairs, the property offers three bedrooms. The main bedroom is a generous and beautifully presented room featuring an excellent array of wall and floor storage, recessed lighting and carpet flooring. Feature panelling behind the headboard creates a stylish focal point and adds to the sense of quality throughout the room.
Bedroom two is another spacious double bedroom, overlooking the rear garden and benefiting from built-in wardrobes and laminate flooring. It provides an excellent secondary bedroom with plenty of storage and natural light.
Bedroom three has been cleverly converted into a superb walk-in wardrobe. Providing extensive shelving and ample hanging space, this room offers an outstanding amount of storage and is a particularly appealing feature for those looking for a dedicated dressing and wardrobe area. Laminate flooring completes the room.
The family bathroom continues the property's contemporary theme and has been finished to a high standard. The room features fully tiled flooring, a concealed-cistern WC, wash hand basin, large wall-mounted mirror and a generous shower area incorporating both a rainfall shower and power shower. The clean lines and modern finishes create a bright and luxurious bathroom space.
Outside, the property continues to impress. The rear garden has been fully paved, creating a low-maintenance and highly usable outdoor space, while mature hedging provides a good degree of privacy and enclosure. A superb garden room completes the rear garden. Fully wired and insulated, the garden room offers excellent versatility and could be used as a home office, home gym, hobby room or simply as additional garden storage, depending on the requirements of the new owners.
To the front, there is ample off-street parking for up to three cars. The front garden incorporates gravelled parking to one side, with the original concrete driveway positioned to the other. This driveway also provides access to an exceptionally wide side passage, giving excellent and convenient access to the rear garden.
The location is another major attraction. Tullyhall Crescent is situated within a peaceful setting while remaining exceptionally convenient to a wide range of amenities and transport links. The property is within walking distance of Griffeen Shopping Centre, while local shops, schools, recreational facilities and public transport options are all close by. Bus stops are approximately five minutes' walk from the property, providing convenient access to surrounding areas and Dublin City.
The property also enjoys excellent access to the M4 and M50 motorways, making it particularly convenient for commuters travelling throughout Dublin and beyond. The surrounding area provides an excellent choice of amenities, while Lucan itself offers a well-established community with a wide range of schools, sporting facilities, shops and services.
